correction.reason: Null is a JSON primitive; its field name must remain visible

findings: Read-only public validity getters synchronize native control attributes; scoped observation prevents feedback loops.
Pinned upstream JsonTree correction preserves field keys for null primitives.
Embedded fonts survive the second bundle and load in all engines.
Firefox serializes FontFace.family with quotes; assertion normalizes observed serialization.
limits: Final packed-consumer installation is a separate release gate.
Closed shadow roots and standalone external CSSOM mutations are outside automatic observation.
The three engine checks do not replace actual Safari or assistive technology testing.
